protocol.primary: mean pilot routed fraction relative to strongest valid baseline
protocol.gate: candidate paired mean routed-fraction gain >= .03, positive in >= 2/3 seeds, and greater than each component ablation; observed excess error <= .05
protocol.interpretation: Fixed global pools: train+tune, calibration, pilot, fresh, final. Only train/tune assignment varies by seed. Fresh and final rows never enter pilot fitting/calibration/evaluation. Final 10% never transformed or predicted until gated full run. No tuning on calibration labels.
